scope: Developer-only benchmark; no live student matching changes

rule.correlation: Pearson across six official RIASEC raw totals and existing occupation vectors
rule.fill: Only nonnegative correlations, highest first; final display by band then alphabetical
rule.eligibility: Primary keeps current complete, nonflat, non-near-flat guard. Manual-only nonflat sensitivity is separate.
rule.unknownJobZone: Reported separately; excluded from official-zone returned counts.
rule.education: All five existing education-route groups; Job Zone is separate.
rule.income: Never used in interest scoring or selection
rule.specificAnswers: Not used in official interest similarity; contrary and reviewHold flags displayed separately
rule.scoreMeaning: Correlation is not probability, aptitude, admission, readiness or confirmed profession fit

splits.holdoutLimitation: Split fixed before original outcomes; previous aggregate results have been seen. No threshold tuning in this benchmark.
